verdict.rationale: Grafana ships clear self-hosting mechanics: version-controlled provisioning/GitOps for dashboards and data sources, local/monolithic deployment guidance, and explicit Loki migration/upgrade docs, all pointing to a real self-hosted production path. However, community evidence shows real friction with running the 'full stack' (needing to add/configure Alertmanager and other services) and notable legal/licensing concern from the AGPL change that has caused some companies to restrict or avoid self-hosted production use. Missing for 10: a consolidated production reference architecture doc, independent verification that upgrades across the full stack (Loki+Tempo+Mimir+Grafana) are smooth, and resolution of the AGPL licensing friction reported by ops teams.
